items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: And the next thing they did with Wes was with Oliver Nelson

ctx.x: Wes wasn't really a total stranger to them when he talked about it, but he did have a little something going there. And "Finger Pickin'" was getting some play when they introduced Wes to Riverside Records. Riverside brought him in and they did an album. The first album was with Jimmy Jones. I remember the album vaguely. I wish I could get my hands on it now, because I remember it was different. It was a good album.

But then someone heard the sound, I think it was Creed Taylor. And the next thing they did with Wes was with Oliver Nelson, and they came out with "Going Out of My Head." I don't have to tell you what that did for him.
